name: Public Website / Route House Front Door
purpose: Create the public-facing Kingsmen front door: route-house positioning, sector universe preview, free Destiny Map lead capture, pricing boundaries, trust language, proof-safe claims, and candidate portal handoff.
locked_laws: Kingsmen must be publicly presented as a private route house / private route command house.
Kingsmen must not be presented as a cheap application-help service.

The public site sells direction, protection, positioning, evidence, speed, route intelligence, document readiness, opportunity confidence, accommodation stability, CV/motivation strength, fallback, and managed execution.
All sectors remain visible to every user from the public website.
Packages control campaign weight, intensity, managed count, monitoring, priority, and execution support; packages must not control dignity or sector access.
Free Destiny Map is R0 with 0 managed applications and all-sector preview only.
Exact institution/company/portal/programme/bursary/accommodation targets, application links, and manual route plans remain sealed until package activation.
CV Revamp is R49.99 and includes 15 personalised CV versions plus 15 matching motivation letters.
Accommodation Support Package is R179.00 for 8 accommodation applications/routes standalone.
Every paid Kingsmen package includes up to 8 ACC-01 accommodation routes.
Never invent fake experience, qualifications, references, certificates, skills, testimonials, acceptance claims, deadlines, fees, official status, or official relationships.
Kingsmen is not an official university, TVET, SETA, NSFAS, CAO, employer, bursary provider, accommodation provider, payment provider, or government portal.
No guarantee of admission, funding, employment, accommodation, approval, or official response speed.
Public forms must be smart and document-aware: do not force users to type details already extracted from CVs and uploaded documents.
Candidate communication remains email-first; WhatsApp is urgent-only.
Public lead intake must hand off to N04 candidate core and N05 document vault without bypassing consent, POPIA, or profile confirmation.
Public website content must route through content guardrails before publishing.
No public page may expose sealed route intelligence reserved for activated packages.
The public website must be Oracle Lite deployable and static-first where possible.
